name: 사냥꾼의 활
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: single fantasy inventory pixel-art sprite. First input image is edit target (or original design to restore). Preserve current pixel-art style, coarse square clusters, dark stepped outlines, palette and proportions except explicitly requested changes. Keep the exact wooden bow, green grip wrap, silver end caps, string, orientation, palette and chunky pixels. Remove the single white feather charm from CENTER GRIP. Instead attach TWO small white feather charms, one tied to UPPER bow end and one tied to LOWER bow end. Each is attached with a short brown cord at its respective silver end cap; both contained inside canvas with clear outlines, not cropped. Exactly two feathers total; no feather at center. Maintain narrow1x3 inventory silhouette and transparent background.
Return exactly ONE item. No text labels, watermark, grid or backdrop. Preserve real alpha transparency; no black background. No blurring or antialias smoothing. Full object with safe transparent margins. Inventory footprint (# occupied, . empty), top-to-bottom: #/#/#
